name: get_zapier_skill
description: Fetch the full content of a Zapier Skill by name. ALWAYS call this before executing a skill — the response includes the skill instructions AND the schemas for all referenced tools so you know exactly how to call them. The "zapier-mcp-onboarding" skill is always available and should be used by default when onboarding a new user.

name.description: The exact name of the skill to retrieve
